description: This Java source file defines an unmodifiable implementation of the ExternalMessage interface used for messaging between actors in the Eclipse Ditto project. The class encapsulates message headers, payloads, context, and various optional metadata, enforcing immutability for message integrity.

classes.name: UnmodifiableExternalMessage
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ExternalMessage interface, representing a message with headers, payload, and optional metadata for use within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of message headers.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with an added header.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with additional headers.

methods.name: withTopicPath
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with a different topic path.

methods.name: findHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a header value by key, if present and not empty.

methods.name: findHeaderIgnoreCase
methods.description: Retrieves a header value by key, ignoring case.

methods.name: isTextMessage
methods.description: Checks if the message payload is a text message.

methods.name: isBytesMessage
methods.description: Checks if the message payload is in bytes.

methods.name: getTextPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the text payload if available.

methods.name: getBytePayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the byte payload if available.

methods.name: getPayloadType
methods.description: Returns the payload type of the message.

methods.name: isResponse
methods.description: Indicates if the message is a response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Indicates if the message represents an error.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the authorization context.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the message's topic path.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the enforcement filter.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the header mapping.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the payload mapping.

methods.name: getSourceAddress
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the source address.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the source object.

methods.name: getInternalHeaders
methods.description: Returns internal Ditto headers.
